svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Gold for the Christmas beetle
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink editorial cartoon set in an Australian suburban backyard with a weatherboard house, water tank, Hills hoist, paling fence and gum tree. On a homemade podium of three wooden crates under an Insect of the Year banner, a shiny gold Christmas beetle wears a winner's medal, a spotted ladybird stands in second place and a glowing glow-worm in third. A fictional grandfather in a bush hat leans in with a magnifying glass, saying it is the first one he has seen since the eighties, while a fictional girl photographs the beetle on her phone for the beetle count.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
GOLD FOR THE BEETLE. NOW, COME HOME FOR CHRISTMAS.
Source: ABC News, 10 November 2026 — Gold Christmas beetle voted Insect of the Year as scientists track fewer sightings.
